title: Capstone: Build and Verify a Production-style Organization
summary: Prove the whole system in a disposable environment

lessons.title: The task
lessons.body: In a disposable HERMES_HOME, build a two-worker organization that completes a small verified deliverable (a doc set with a deterministic check), under Nerve supervision with HITL active.

lessons.title: Acceptance rubric
lessons.body: 1) Task completes via controller-owned dispatch. 2) At least one consequential prompt answered with justification. 3) Checkpoint capsule exists and resumes. 4) Experience notes record one verified claim. 5) No live profile touched.

lessons.title: Verification
lessons.body: The capstone checker validates artifacts, gates, and isolation automatically; the rubric is in module 9 content.

lab.goal: Complete the capstone in a disposable environment and pass the automated checker.
steps: Run: nerve university --capstone  (creates the disposable fixture)
Complete the deliverable inside the fixture.
lab.expect: Checker exits 0 with five evidence artifacts written under the fixture.

task.intro: Answer the scenario questions; the engine verifies them deterministically in a disposable fixture. Your answers are never executed as commands.

questions.q: Where must the capstone organization be built? (disposable/live)
questions.why: The capstone runs only in a disposable environment.
The learner produces artifacts; the verifier only inspects them.
Truthful reporting of result and limitations is mandatory.

executable.task: Produce the capstone operating plan before building the organization.

check.question: Q: Where must the capstone be built?
expected_keywords: in a disposable environment - never against a live installation

troubleshooting: Labs and capstone never write to live profiles.
The checker verifies isolation as part of acceptance.
